text: Your restaurant bill just added a ten percent service charge.
Can they make you pay it?
C.C.P.A. guidelines, upheld by the Delhi High Court in twenty twenty-five, say
it can't be added by default, made compulsory, or charged under another name.
Like a tip, a service charge is your choice. G S T is a government tax, which you do pay.
Ask them to remove it. Refused? Keep the bill and call 1 9 1 5.
